downsample_image: downsample a numpy image array by a given factor along both dimensions using mean pooling
fill_coords_with_shape: fill pixels of an image with a color where coordinates match a filter function like a circle or line
rotate_filter_function: rotate a coordinate filter function around a center point by a given theta angle in radians
create_point_in_shape_fn: create a predicate function that tests if a point lies inside a line, circle, rectangle, or triangle
highlight_image: add a semi-transparent color highlight overlay to a numpy image array with configurable alpha blending
